title: Met-A for the whole sample and the territories on sequencing
set_out: Find why Met-A for the whole sample and the territories read high on healthy sequenced samples, including those from outside the atlas, and fix it in the chain, synthetic first.
open_at_turnover: Healthy pass 3 (137 inputs, the pooled level, per-site tables) on GitHub; the outside healthy samples read again on Google.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: The healthy level on sequencing: the median of the donors
entries.what: One spent B-cell atlas input read by the one command with a new per-site table of Met-A for the whole sample.
entries.outcome: About a quarter of the reading's weight sat where the expected level was exactly 0 or 1. The atlas's level is the median of 1 to 3 donors, which sits at 0 or 1 wherever a donor has few reads; the pooled count, which the atlas also stores, does so far less. The expectation on sequencing is now the pooled level.

entries.title: The pooled-level synthetic
entries.what: Hidden truth, three donors counted from it, samples at seven depths, read both ways by the one command.
entries.outcome: Not met: the median reading met its bar, the trend with depth narrowly missed its bar; the median of the donors read higher on the same samples. The bar was not changed after the run.

entries.title: The B-cell input with the pooled level
entries.what: The same spent input read again on the fixed chain.
entries.outcome: The islands reading came down to below 1; the remaining excess sits at the marked sites, where this sample's level is lower than the expected one.

entries.title: Commits through a gated runner
entries.what: The working session can no longer keep a .git folder, so each change is committed through GitHub's API to a gate/* branch, and a runner rebases it, rebuilds the generated documents and pushes to main only through CANON/checked_push.sh, the same gate as before.
entries.outcome: The workflow file itself (.github/workflows/gated_merge.yml) was added directly, the one change that did not pass through the gate.

entries.title: Pooled counts in the sequencing atlas's columns at v2.1's sites
entries.what: The array-site columns rebuilt on a Google spot machine with each cell's pooled methylated and all reads.
entries.outcome: Built in minutes; the median and spread columns came out byte-identical to the committed ones.

entries.title: A broken settings block, fixed (disclosed)
entries.what: An insert in stage_metaa_atlas.py matched inside another setting's name, so two settings were missing on main for one commit.
entries.outcome: Fixed and every setting checked present; no reading was made with the broken commit.
